job: Say what will appear here and give the one action that fills it.
purpose: A centred block with an icon or texture, a title, one sentence and one or two actions. It covers a first-use empty state, a search with no match, an error that stopped a load, a feature the plan lacks and being offline. Size sm fits cards and tables; lg fills a page.
useWhen: A list, table or page has no items yet and the next step is clear.
A search or filter matches nothing; say what to change.
A request failed and the reader can retry.
A feature is not on the plan; say which plan has it.
One part of a page-state set (fd-states): no access, not found, switched off, link expired.

avoidWhen.when: The message is a warning above content that exists.
A chart has no data in the range.
A table needs the same states inside its frame.

variants.useWhen: Inside a card, a popover or a table.
A full page with nothing on it yet.
Empty state: something failed or is destructive.
Empty state: something needs attention soon but is not broken.
Empty state: something finished or is healthy.

parts.role: A texture slot behind the text that fades to the edges.
What will appear, in one sentence.
A smaller aside, such as a keyboard tip.
A quiet line under the actions: a request ID, who can grant access or turn an area on, when a link expired.
The one or two actions that fix it.
